artists.biography: Todd Harry Rundgren (born June 22, 1948) is an American multi-instrumentalist, songwriter and record producer. Hailed in the early stage of his career as a new pop star, supported by the certified gold solo double LP Something/Anything? in 1972, his career has produced a diverse range of recordings as solo artist, and during the seventies and eighties with the band Utopia. He has also been prolific as a producer and engineer on the recorded work of other musicians.

Hailed in the early stage of his career as a new pop star, supported by the certified gold solo double LP Something/Anything? in 1972, his career has produced a diverse range of recordings as solo artist, and during the seventies and eighties with the band Utopia. He has also been prolific as a producer and engineer on the recorded work of other musicians.

perplexity.description:
Healing," released in February 1981, is Todd Rundgren's ninth studio album, blending elements of electronic and rock music. The album is notable for its thematic focus on spirituality and the human condition, continuing Rundgren's exploration of introspective and philosophical subjects. Musically, it incorporates a mix of rock, art rock, and contemporary pop/rock styles, with a layered production that reflects Rundgren's interest in cutting-edge technology and studio experimentation at the time.

In the context of Rundgren's discography, "Healing" stands out as a deeply personal and cathartic work, created during a period of intense emotional and professional activity. It followed his prolific late-1970s period as a producer and artist, and included a unique packaging feature: a bonus 7-inch single with the track "Time Heals," which was also promoted with a self-directed video. Rundgren regarded "Healing" as one of his most satisfying albums, aiming to offer comfort and wisdom amid a world he saw as full of critics and destroyers. While not a major commercial breakthrough, the album has been appreciated for its artistic ambition and emotional depth within his body of work.
